subtasks.title: Non-production OTP bypass in CustomLoginPage, with tests
subtasks.approach: Extract sendOtp()'s user-lookup+eligibility check into one private helper. In authenticate(), before the `if (! $this->otp_sent)` branch, add a non-production branch guarded by `! app()->isProduction()`: resolve the eligible user via the helper; if none, throw the same 'Account Not Found' ValidationException sendOtp() throws; otherwise Filament::auth()->login($user) and fall through to the existing shared tail (canAccessAnyPanel re-check, session regenerate, activity log, LoginResponse). Mark the bypass in the activity log instead of the implicit 'N/A'. otp_sent stays false so the OTP field stays hidden and unvalidated - no UI change needed.
subtasks.intended_diffs: CustomLoginPage.php: (a) new private resolveEligibleUser(string $email): ?User holding the User::where('email')->first() + canAccessPanel(client)||canAccessPanel(app) check currently inlined in sendOtp(); (b) sendOtp() rewritten to call it; (c) new non-prod branch at the top of authenticate()'s post-rateLimit body; (d) a $bypassed flag threaded into the activity() properties so the log records BYPASSED_NON_PROD rather than relying on an undefined $otp_data. Test file: 3 new tests per the AC list.

excluded_sites.reason: production OTP path only; the bypass never calls it, so it needs no change
the separate, already-shipped __qa/login dev-login route; referenced as a guard-rigor template, not modified
single wiring point for both panels; the change in CustomLoginPage covers both automatically

notes: Guard is environment-only per the Phase 2 interview: `! app()->isProduction()`. No new config flag, no deploy-workflow change.

$otp_data is currently only assigned inside authenticate()'s else-branch but read in the activity() call via `?? 'N/A'`. The bypass path must not rely on that implicit undefined-variable read - thread an explicit marker instead.

The OTP TextInput is ->required() but ->hidden() while otp_sent is false, and the existing first-submit already relies on hidden fields being skipped by validation - so leaving otp_sent false on the bypass path needs no form change.
